productArea.name: Global search
productArea.scope: Search across entities or Configuration settings, using query syntax, entity scopes, history, keyboard shortcuts, results, and destination links. Check that links reach the intended page without exploring destination features, and leave the command menu to Home and application navigation.

entryPoints.directions: Choose Search in the sidebar or press / to open entity search, then use its scopes, history, and syntax help.
Use the settings search field to find Configuration cards and check their destination links.
